modules.name: unsigned_adder
modules.responsibility: Implement unsigned addition, the single output data/valid register, elastic handshake logic, and synchronous reset. No memories or submodules.

ports.name: rst_n
ports.semantics: Active-low synchronous reset; on a sampled low edge clear output data and valid and suppress transfers.

ports.name: in_valid
ports.semantics: Shared validity of in_a and in_b.

ports.name: in_ready
ports.semantics: Combinational rst_n AND (NOT out_valid OR out_ready).

ports.name: in_a
ports.semantics: First unsigned operand, sampled only on input transfer.

ports.name: in_b
ports.semantics: Second unsigned operand, sampled on the same transfer as in_a.

ports.name: out_valid
ports.semantics: Registered slot occupancy; reset clears, input transfer sets, output-only transfer clears, otherwise holds.

ports.name: out_ready
ports.semantics: Enables consumption and simultaneous replacement of a valid output on a non-reset edge.

ports.name: out_sum
ports.semantics: Registered sum of zero-extended operands; write on input transfer, clear on sampled reset, otherwise hold. Old data transfers on a simultaneous replacement edge.
